capture.zh: 在斯诺星岩洞挑战魔狮迪露（50级，总体力300万）；打败获得魔狮迪露精元（孵化得露露）。

strategy_notes.zh: 先叠加寄生、冻伤、烧伤或中毒的持续伤害；体力严格低于100万后无法新增异常，但已有异常继续生效。本作按用户选定规则：体力严格低于25%时，下一次攻击必先且必定击倒对手；恢复到25%及以上则退出该状态。

engine_notes: HP 3,000,000 in ONE battle (not a server-wide pool): every source frames it as a single fight beaten by stacking percentage damage — 寄生/冻伤/烧伤/中毒 each take 1/8 max HP (375,000) per turn, so 3-4 stacked statuses kill it in 2-3 turns. No source describes HP carrying over between battles, so no chain/carry_hp is used (correcting the foundation 7.2 guess).
ignore_type_chart: 不受任何系精灵克制 — every hit on it uses multiplier 1.

V57 user-adopted policy: current HP strictly below 25% forces a damaging move before any opposing move priority or speed and directly KOs its target, bypassing accuracy and protection. Exactly 25% and above use ordinary behavior; healing ends this mode. Historical guides conflict between 50% and 25%, so this is an explicit remake decision, not an official-server claim.
block_new_status strictly below 1,000,000 HP (他血低于100万时异常效果无效): use the absolute HP threshold, not a rounded percentage. New statuses fail; statuses already on it keep ticking.

V57 replaces the unquantified damage_scales_with_hp_lost declaration with the explicit below-25% execution policy. No gradual damage multiplier is inferred. All four unrelated waived mechanics are recorded in data/boss-user-policies-v57.json.
Not immune to ohko ops: 极度冰点 and 绝命火焰 were standard answers.
Status damage here follows RULES 7: poison/burn/freeze/leech each take 1/8 max HP per turn (percent damage), and several DoT statuses can be on the boss at once (classic 叠加异常).
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
One-hit-KO skills (极度冰点) stopped working on it in the 2009-12-30 patch; its own forced execution below 25% is unaffected.
source_note: 4399 & 7k7k (2010-05/06): 50级 总体力300万, 不受任何系克制, 150万以下秒杀, 100万以下异常无效, 不免疫冻伤/烧伤/中毒/寄生. Runtime V57 threshold is separately user-adopted: strictly below 25%; conflicting historical thresholds are retained as provenance, not executed.
